meta.title: Balance Game — Couple Trip (Extreme)
meta.description: A partner who gets lost on the trip vs one who books the wrong hotel. Twelve extreme rounds reveal your couple-travel style.

startMessage.line1: Partner lost mid-trip vs partner who botched the hotel booking—what would you pick?
startMessage.line2: Couple trips are thrilling and messy. One small mishap can flip the whole mood. Choosing between two imperfect options shows what you value on the road—and how you move.
startMessage.line3: Twelve extreme rounds reveal your couple-travel style. You'll see “people who picked like you ○%” each round—then compare types with friends.
startMessage.line4: Start the extreme picks ⚖️ Keep it quick

results.title: Packed days on a tight plan — Schedule Power Type
results.shortDescription: A designer who fills the trip with minute-level planning
results.quote: You design the trip ahead and chase rich routes packed with experiences.
results.description: Efficiency and steadiness are strengths—but slipped plans spike stress, and your partner can feel out of breath.
results.characteristics: design, efficiency, packed days, tight pace
results.livingStyle: Books and routes locked; every day is full
results.strengths: Few mishaps; lots of experiences, steadily delivered
results.caution: Little flexibility when things change; partner may burn out
results.goodMatch: Spontaneous Romantic (they add ease and romance)
results.tips:
Leave 30 spare minutes in every block
Pick one "optional skip" spot each day
Slot in one partner pick once a day
results.oneLiner: Solid prep is power. One blank cell lets the trip breathe.
results.shareLine: Balance Game — Couple Trip Extreme result: Schedule Power 📋 Apparently I pack trips minute by minute lol What'd you get? Lost mid-trip vs wrong hotel—your pick?

results.title: No fixed plan, follow the view — Spontaneous Romantic
results.shortDescription: A feel-first type who trusts mood and scenery
results.quote: You wander where your feet go and savor time slowly.
results.description: You create accidental magic—but thin prep can mean getting lost or missing things.
results.livingStyle: Ducks into cafés that catch your eye; plans follow the day's mood
results.caution: Vulnerable to booking flubs and getting lost
results.goodMatch: Schedule Power (they hold structure so you can enjoy)
results.tips:
Lock lodging and transit at least
Keep just three must-see backups
Agree on a joke line when plans go sideways
results.oneLiner: Romance is the flavor of travel. A thin safety net makes it perfect.
results.shareLine: Balance Game — Couple Trip Extreme result: Spontaneous Romantic 🌅 Apparently I follow the scenery and take it slow… What'd you get? Lost mid-trip vs wrong hotel—your pick?

results.title: Prep for comfort, then rest hard — Cozy Recharge Type
results.shortDescription: A healing type who sets comfort first, then recharges
results.quote: You lock in a comfy stay and a loose route, then truly rest.
results.description: Low drain and steady—but an active partner may feel underwhelmed.
results.livingStyle: Books a good stay and keeps the schedule soft
results.caution: Fewer new experiences; can feel samey
results.goodMatch: Active Explorer (they add spark and balance)
results.tips:
Do one activity they want each day
Split rest and move roughly half-and-half
Pin one new place in advance
results.oneLiner: A recharging trip matters. One activity adds a memory.
results.shareLine: Balance Game — Couple Trip Extreme result: Cozy Recharge ☕ Apparently I set comfort first and rest hard lol What'd you get? Lost mid-trip vs wrong hotel—your pick?

results.title: Wander and explore — Active Explorer
results.shortDescription: An adventure type who moves free and hunts new places
results.quote: You move on impulse and chase new experiences.
results.description: The trip feels alive—but stamina, schedule, and budget can fray, and your partner may struggle to keep up.
results.livingStyle: Goes where it looks fun; tries activities first, asks later
results.strengths: Drive that isn't afraid of the new
results.goodMatch: Cozy Recharge (they build the rest nest for balance)
results.tips:
Guarantee them one rest window daily
Front-load active stuff in the morning; free the afternoon
Ask about their energy before deciding
results.oneLiner: Adventure is magnetic. Match their pace—and their rest.
